# Winifred Tolley

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 c37 P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Winifred  <sub>[v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Winifred has a healthy, circular, pink-and-white complexion paired with cheerful brown eyes. Her blonde hair is styled into a rigid, tiny bun secured firmly by an elastic band around her head rather than hat pins. Her countenance lacks the look of a conventional old maid.

_Sources: [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019)_

## Personality

Known for having a sharp, sharp-tongued manner with men, Miss Winifred balances an outspoken dislike of them with a compassionate heart. She is prompt to assist anyone in difficulty and refrains from making cruel remarks about other women. Pragmatic and not easily troubled by nerves, she handles life's realities calmly, though she holds deep-seated prejudices against Methodists and overly grandiloquent speech.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P38](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0038), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c13 P3](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0003), [v4 c26 P25](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0025), [v4 c30 P48](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0048)_

## History

Miss Winifred was an only child for eight years before her younger brother was born. Her mother passed away before the boy reached three years old, leaving Winifred to care for him as both sister and mother until his death in his early twenties. During her youth, she had many suitors and could choose whomever she wanted. She also won an award for her lemon pies at the Port Marlow Exhibition. Along with other women of her parish, she took charge to organize, fundraise, and construct the Presbyterian church at Glen St. Agnes in six months. Later in life, she became a close friend and practical supporter of Lorna Vane, helping her around her home and defending her against neighborhood gossip. She regularly visited Nell Carrow and engaged in lively verbal sparring matches with her longtime companion, Captain Saul. Though known as a confirmed hater of men, she eventually agreed to marry Ambrose Kerr.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c10 P35](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0035), [v4 c10 P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 c13 P3](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0003), [v4 c15 P7](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0007), [v4 c15 P32](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0032), [v4 c18 P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v4 c34 P26](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0026), [v4 c34 P28](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0028), [v4 c36 P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027), [v4 c37 P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008)_
